name: Should I choose an L-shaped or U-shaped kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose an L-shaped or U-shaped kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between an L-shape and U-shape layout depends on your room dimensions and whether you want an open floor plan. An L-shaped layout opens the kitchen into adjacent living areas, easily accommodates a central freestanding island, and handles multiple family members moving through the room. A U-shaped layout maximizes perimeter cabinet storage and countertop workspace, making it ideal for dedicated home cooks in enclosed spaces. However, U-shaped rooms can feel cramped if the floor width between opposing counters is under eight feet, and corner cabinets require careful hardware planning to avoid dead space.
acceptedAnswer.description: L-shaped layouts work best for open-concept homes and central islands. U-shaped layouts offer more storage and counter space but require sufficient width to avoid feeling cramped.
